r.notes: Was high in the tree, no sign of browning on behind. Stayed in same fork all day and moved further up tree in the late evening. Was in a tree in a thin (3-4m wide) strip of vegetation that runs along a shared access drive for several suburban homes. Vegetation is weedy remnant bushland connected to Moogurrupum Creek
Has been seen hanging around this area quite regularly recently
It had milky coloured eyes, like cataracts.Called Redlands Wildlife Ambulance but were unable to capture.

Please Stop cutting down their homes and they wouldn’t have to cross main roads to find a tiny bit of bush to live in.  Poor animals. More road kill than you can poke a stick at around the bayside it’s twrrible.
It was first bridge before roundabout on boundary road crossing the road. Look only young
It had just crossed the road and was walking back up the embankment
Boundary St, Redland Bay.  Sighting emailed to KAG.
